corrections.text: The article's Overview states Harper 'shipped version 5.2 ... on August 20, 2026 ... according to Harper's release announcement and InfoQ, which dated the release to August 20.' Harper's own release-announcement post is bylined August 6, 2026, and Harper's technical deep-dive on the same release is bylined August 17, 2026; neither states an explicit ship date in its text. August 20, 2026 is InfoQ's own article publish date, not a release date stated in InfoQ's body text, which says only that Harper 'recently released version 5.2.' The precise Harper 5.2 ship date is not confirmed by the cited sources beyond a window of roughly August 6-20, 2026.
